title: Dynamics 365 finance and operations: migrate environments from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center
summary: Hold: the migration guidance omits Microsoft's warning to retain a Lifecycle Services sandbox while production still depends on it for updates. The updated documentation also names a Lifecycle Services project role, contrary to the briefing's blanket absence statement; the migration prerequisites themselves still do not specify that role.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Lifecycle Services deployment and promotion workflows stop managing a migrated sandbox, with the guidance planning production last.
claims.quote: If production is still managed in Lifecycle Services, you can't promote updates, including custom code changes, to production until you migrate production to the Power Platform admin center.
claims.fix: Keep the statement about migrated sandbox workflows, but append its documented last-sandbox qualification: 'Keep at least one sandbox in Lifecycle Services until you are ready to migrate production; migrating the last sandbox while production remains there prevents promotion of updates, including custom code changes, to production until production is migrated.' Carry that qualification into the production-last checklist bullet. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/lifecycle-services/migrate-lifecycle-services-environments-power-platform-admin-center#recommended-migration-sequence.

claims.where: Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout; controls[2].governs
claims.claim: Linking the finance and operations environment to a Power Platform environment is a migration prerequisite.
claims.quote: Link the environment to a Power Platform environment. For more information, see Enable the Power Platform integration.

claims.claim: Enabling dual-write is not required for migration.
claims.quote: You don't have to enable dual-write to migrate an environment.

claims.claim: The migration page names no Lifecycle Services project role.
claims.quote: Manage the environment through Lifecycle Services project roles, such as Project owner | Assign the Power Platform administrator role in Microsoft Entra ID or an environment admin role.
claims.fix: Replace 'The page names no Lifecycle Services project role' with 'The migration prerequisites do not specify a Lifecycle Services project role.' The updated article names Project owner only when explaining post-migration administration alternatives, not as a migration prerequisite.

claims.claim: Migration is started in Lifecycle Services at project > Environments > environment > Full details > Power Platform migration (Preview) > Migrate to Power Platform Admin Center.
claims.quote: open the project that contains the environment. ... In the Environments section ... select Full details. ... expand Power Platform migration (Preview). ... Select Migrate to Power Platform Admin Center.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for starting this Lifecycle Services-to-Power Platform management migration as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Lifecycle Services Power Platform environment migration API start migration PowerShell pac admin; Lifecycle Services migration Power Platform API reference. Read migration steps and pac admin copy and LCS-to-unified copy results; these document UI or copying, not this migration API.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The finance and operations storage report is in Power Platform admin center at Licensing > Capacity add-ons > Finance and Operations.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Power Platform admin center. ... select Licensing. ... select Capacity add-ons. ... Select Finance and Operations.

claims.claim: No API equivalent for the finance and operations storage report is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: finance operations storage capacity report API PowerShell pac admin; finance and operations capacity API; Operations capacity Get-AdminPowerAppEnvironment. Opened the report and daily-capacity tutorial; read cmdlet reference excerpts. No Operations-report equivalent stated.

claims.claim: The integration prerequisite is checked in Lifecycle Services at project > Environments > environment > Full details > Power Platform migration (Preview) > Power Platform environment is linked.
claims.quote: open the project that contains the environment. ... In the Environments section ... select Full details. ... expand Power Platform migration (Preview). ... Power Platform environment is linked.

claims.claim: GET [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.1/RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails is the documented Dataverse call for checking integration status.
claims.quote: The RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails API is available in Dataverse to validate the status of the Power Platform integration ... GET [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.1/RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails

claims.claim: The Dataverse call checks whether integration exists and returns finance and operations environment details, rather than initiating migration.
claims.quote: If the Power Platform environment is linked to a finance and operations apps environment through the Power Platform integration, the API returns the Microsoft Entra tenant and environment details of the finance and operations apps environment.

claims.claim: The integration article does not state which role may call RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails.
claims.quote: Searched: RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails permission role. Opened the complete integration article and read its runtime-status section, request, response and properties; no caller role is stated there.

claims.claim: The migration section shows four green-check prerequisites for Deployed status, linkage, available database storage and linked-environment administrator status.
claims.quote: Environment is in Deployed status. ... Power Platform environment is linked. ... Database storage capacity is available. ... You are an administrator of the linked Power Platform environment.

claims.claim: Microsoft directs administrators to keep the maintenance window open and wait for Migration status to show Migrated.
claims.quote: Keep the maintenance window open while the migration runs. ... Wait until Migration status is Migrated, and then select Open in Power Platform Admin Center.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The guidance asks readers to review and agree administrator access without a corresponding access-management control in the table.
claims.quote: review who holds that role before migration day; agree who will be the administrator of that linked environment. The controls table contains migration initiation, capacity reporting and integration-status checks, not access management.
claims.fix: Remove 'so review who holds that role before migration day' and replace 'agree who will be the administrator of that linked environment' with 'confirm the person starting migration is an administrator of the linked environment'. Do not add a control row.

claims.claim: The existing finance and operations storage report shows organizational usage against licence entitlement.
claims.quote: The finance and operations storage capacity report shows how much finance and operations storage your organization is using compared with how much its license entitles it to.

claims.claim: The storage report covers the tenant's environments, supporting tenant scope for the capacity check.
claims.quote: Storage reporting covers usage at the tenant and environment level. All environments in all Lifecycle Services projects on the tenant are included in storage reporting.

claims.claim: No new data location is documented for this control-plane migration.
claims.quote: Searched: migrate Lifecycle Services Power Platform database location migration. Opened the migration article, integration article and unified overview; migration says the database is not moved and infrastructure is not materially changed, and specifies no new data location.
